tested_semantics.authority_rule: lowered program may carry effect intent/signature but must not embed or mint EffectPermit authority

attack_classes: drop or alter declared effect signature during lowering
serialize/embed a model-visible permit token into generated code
lower foreign call without an explicit unsafe FFI trust boundary

observed_failure_and_repair.initial_attempt: A larger run used 100 separate-process smokes with a 3-second subprocess timeout; one Python interpreter startup exceeded the timeout and invalidated that attempt.
observed_failure_and_repair.repair: Reran the complete experiment from scratch with 20k differential programs, one 15-second separate-process smoke, 10k identity cases and 40k boundary mutations.
observed_failure_and_repair.scientific_effect: No result from the failed attempt was counted. The slower interpreter startup demonstrates that process-boundary latency must be measured separately from semantic correctness.

expected_vs_observed: All reference semantic/effect traces matched the generated lowering; all constructed authority/effect-signature/FFI boundary mutations were rejected; no benign lowering was rejected.
epistemic_boundary: Finite constructed mechanism test only. It is not a formal soundness proof, real WASI/native/GPU/FFI execution, cryptographic capability test, or production FRANK measurement.
